convention: Inclusive date difference; subtract Sundays and listed holidays within the submitted interval, even when the difference is negative. Arithmetic does not silently apply separate date-policy rules.

criteria.requirement: Rows sorted by scenario (alphabetical), then titre (alphabetical), then langue (alphabetical).
planning_scenarios.csv has exactly 36 rows (3×12), 10 named columns, valid scenario/statut/sous_seuil enums, no missing/unknown/duplicate (scenario,titre,langue) keys.
In scenario dates_fixes, date_livraison_manuscrit, date_relecture, and date_parution must exactly match agenda_editorial_v3.csv for every titre/langue.
fenetre_jours_calendaires = relecture − livraison + 1 (inclusive); fenetre_jours_ouvrables = cal_days − Sundays − listed 2025 holidays in [livraison, relecture], correct in all three scenarios.
In scenario compression, date_livraison_manuscrit = agenda livraison + 14 days; date_relecture and date_parution unchanged from agenda v3.

In scenario glissement, use the compression window to identify affected translated DE/EN rows (<10 working days). For affected rows other than the non-displaceable Atlas des Migrations DE event, retain the delayed manuscript delivery, move publication +14 days from agenda v3, and recalculate review as publication minus 7 days. An affected non-displaceable event retains compression dates. All unaffected rows, including FR, retain dates_fixes dates, as the public instruction explicitly requires.
sous_seuil_10j = 'oui' iff fenetre_jours_ouvrables < 10, 'non' otherwise, in every row.
